body:
New authorized source-only Smart Preview UI task. Your Save As3ca3e9c9 remains preserved; A compiler gates pending. A retains Smart Preview Rust/storage/renderer and all main merges. Please take bounded Swift Library/Develop UI ownership on a NEW codex/smart-preview-ui branch from current origin/main, preserving existing branch/worktrees. No builds/apps/benchmarks or heartbeat restart; source-only, all tests UNRUN until A gates.

Frozen native API (implementation in preparation on A, bindings NOT generated yet): enum SmartPreviewState { Missing, Ready, OriginalOffline, Dirty, Stale, Failed, Conflict }; record SmartPreviewInfo { image_id:String, state:SmartPreviewState, original_available:bool, dirty:bool, width:u32, height:u32, message:String }. Engine methods build_smart_preview(image_id)->Info, smart_preview_info(image_id)->Info, discard_smart_preview(image_id)->(), synchronize_smart_preview(image_id)->Info, open_smart_preview_develop_session(image_id)->DevelopSession. UniFFI Swift names use existing camelCase mapping; no guessed generated-source edits. Info state plus dirty/originalAvailable drive display. Conflict/stale/failed never mean successful sync. Native methods block; call off MainActor. No proxy export API; full-quality export needs matching original and reconciled edits, reports error otherwise.

Implement source-only Swift adapters/controllers with test injection, then Library Build/Discard/Sync Smart Previews for selected engine-backed RAW photos, per-photo results/progress and cancellation BETWEEN photos (native current single build has no cancellation handle; label honestly). Prefer an explicit Use Smart Previews preference/source choice; default usable after build, fallback Original only when safe and visible, never discard pending offline edits. Show Smart Preview / Original offline / pending edits / stale / conflict with accessibility. Develop opener must choose the actual requested native session, maintain current generation-safe cancellation/recovery and close semantics; source badge must reflect actual opened route. Avoid changing Document/SaveAs. Existing MainActor opening/activation/recovery rules remain intact. Keep additions in focused Swift files plus minimal AppModel/AppCommands/DevelopController/ThumbnailCell integration. Read local SwiftUI skill if applicable. Test models using injected async APIs: selection generation, batch cancel, error/conflict not success, stale completion suppression, original-vs-proxy opener, dirty-discard error and badge labels. No speculative facade that advertises unavailable functionality; handoff requires A native API+generated bindings before app can compile.

Reference design+plan on main: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-smart-previews.md and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-28-smart-previews.md. Existing CPU in-memory source147pass/1ignored integrated2ab94fd9; export/Adobe guardrepair44pass integratedfa7372b9. Current rendering correctness-first CPU; no measured faster-interactive claim or lossy-DNG label. Original photos untouched. Full source handoff with exactbase/commits, changedfiles, testlistUNRUN and known integration limitations via Git mailbox targeted A UUID. A alone coordinates compiler and main; no overlap with its Rust agents.
